account-locked: Tëj nañu kont bi ci diir bu gàtt ndax jéem yu bari yu lajj ngir dugg. Jéemaatal gannaaw.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel bi SuperAdmin bi rekk la jagool, ci domen bu Cloud Panel bi.
cloud-settings-desc: Ak WeKan ci Weddy, Cloud Panel bi dafay jox ay domen yu bare yu WeKan ci benn serwëer, ku nekk ak ay donneeam. Ci domen bu Cloud Panel bi, SuperAdmin bi moo yor domen yi ak CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ak caabi CloudFlare API, domen bu zone bi nekk ci sa kont CloudFlare dina am ab enregistrement DNS bu proxy ak ab sertifika CloudFlare Origin. Yeneen domen yi dinañu am ab sertifika Let's Encrypt. Caabi bi dañu koy denc ci serwëer bi te duñu ko wone mukk ci kanam.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Amul caabi CloudFlare API bu ñu denc: domen bu nekk dina am ab sertifika Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Ab caabi CloudFlare API denc nañu ko.
error-ldap-login: Am na njuumte bi ngay jéem a dugg
error-notAuthorized: Amuloo ndigal ngir gis xët wii.
